headline: Boston College seeks statement win over wounded Miami squad
subhead: The fourth-ranked Eagles host a Hurricanes team searching for answers after another loss.

xFactor.why: Boston College's defense just limited Penn State to 22 points and has grown considerably since mid-season; Miami's offense remains inconsistent.

keyMatchup: Boston College's run defense against Miami's ground game will determine whether the Eagles can dictate tempo and keep the Hurricanes' passing attack off rhythm.
body: Miami arrives in Chestnut Hill having lost five of seven and looking increasingly fragmented after dropping to Clemson last week. The Hurricanes' offensive line continues to struggle, and that dysfunction was on full display against a relentless Clemson pass rush. Boston College, meanwhile, has found genuine traction in recent weeks, most notably shutting down Penn State's explosive offense in a dominant 44-22 road victory that signaled this team belongs in the conversation.

The Eagles' defensive front has become a real asset—they collapse gaps effectively and force quarterbacks into hurried decisions. Miami's passing game cannot afford another week of poor protection, and if Boston College's secondary plays with the same confidence it showed against Penn State, the Hurricanes will struggle to sustain drives. Boston College's staff has this team believing it can compete with anyone, and Miami, still searching for stability, is precisely the kind of opponent a hungry fourth-ranked team dispatches at home.
